scope: Bounded public-web discovery of primary geological and planetary-literature sources for three previously generated Idaho footprints. This is not an exhaustive bibliographic review.

queries.query: site.usgs.gov Magic Reservoir latitude longitude Shoshone lava field Idaho

queries.purpose: Review aliases of the volcanic field inside sample 04.

queries.limit: Nearby large buttes are not assigned to a sampled footprint without coordinate containment.
Prior use of the exact sample 09 footprint as a Jezero terrain analog was not established.
Regional planetary-research context does not establish an experimental footprint for sample 09.
No conclusion of scientific novelty follows from an unsuccessful narrow search.

decisions.idaho-sample-04: Retain the archived numerical result as historical evidence. Withhold current ranking because the area contains the BLM Magic Reservoir reference point. Black Butte also has prior planetary research.
decisions.idaho-sample-06: Prior planetary analogy is documented at the Rock Corral Butte landform. The regional Jezero index evaluates a different, coarse terrain comparison.
decisions.idaho-sample-09: Geological context is supported by published USGS vent coordinates. Prior use of the exact footprint and scientific novelty remain unverified. Retain only a regional-terrain desktop hypothesis.
